scope: All 8411 registered target URLs, status per page
completionPolicy: A route or template cannot imply an approved finished page. Each required gate needs evidence and human approval. Approved/released status is not editable by this static viewer.

groups.label: Keyword, SERP & Search Architecture
items: Primary query and related clusters supported by query/source records
Fresh SERP and search intent review
Actual result analysis; commercial, local, informational or transactional intent
Sourced questions reflect actual questions rather than AI speculation
Page-specific SERP copy with no index-wide boilerplate
Semantic H1–H5 outline and content coverage
One H1 and accurate headings supported by original body
Applicable WebPage, TouristAttraction, LocalBusiness etc actually validated
Canonical native path, status code, sitemap and no fragment indexing reliance
Links to parent, peers, entities and meaningful next actions

groups.label: Original Editorial & Factual Quality
items: Original researched article for this exact URL
Not generic topic filler or mechanically duplicated location paragraph
Each factual claim grounded; time-sensitive content refreshed
Local specificity, named entities and geography
Park gateways, town, feature or individual business verified
Access, time, route, permits, seasons, safety as relevant
Original FAQ/PAA answers and fact verification
Direct usable answers, no misleading live promises
Editorial E-E-A-T, byline, safety and disclosures
Author/reviewer, expertise, corrections and transparency present

groups.label: Dopamine-Rich Visual / Photo System
items: Real photo left, strong copy right, more than one slide and functioning controls
Distinct authorized hero image per slide
Location-accurate, large, recognizable, correctly framed imagery
Photography on destination and business cards
Named item media, no fake merchant property photography or empty blocks
Carousels, immersive photography, video where appropriate, real user journey
Descriptive filename, srcset, alt, copyright/attribution, consent and image load QA

groups.label: Design Meeting Flow / Responsive UX
items: Cross-site design tokens and approved identity
Brand, typography, colors, spacing, buttons and card standards
Working in-page links, controls and CTAs
No dead buttons, false bookings, misleading rewards or unsupported checkout
Desktop, tablet and actual mobile screenshot QA
Screenshot evidence at approved responsive breakpoints
Carousel operates with arrows, swipe, keyboard and accessible labels
Relevant topical navigation, business discovery and next steps

groups.label: Actual Park / Directory / Commerce Data
items: Canonical ID, documented source, verified place data
Real coordinates, anchor, radius rules and provenance; N/A only if reviewed
Real operating status, address, approved photos, category, ownership where claimed
Current inventory, time, price, terms or explicitly excluded and gated

groups.label: Page-By-Page Review & Release Gate
items: Original design request, task ID, comments and accountable owner
Exact page, desktop/tablet/iPhone screenshot and code/commit proof
SEO, images, links, privacy and accessibility tests pass
Automated checks plus independent human review evidence
Authorized human approval recorded in GitHub
Review decision, reviewer ID/date; publication forbidden before sign-off
